name: Radiation and nuclear safety
what: Hold a state licence to deal with radiation sources, and a Commonwealth permit to possess nuclear material.

layers.who: Australian Safeguards and Non-Proliferation Office (nuclear material)

consistency_note: States license radiation sources under their own laws; nuclear material is Commonwealth only.

basis.locator: s 59(1) (current republication (R23, from 26 November 2025; Radiation Protection Act 2006 | Acts))
basis.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person intentionally deals with a regulated radiation source; and (b) the dealing by the person is not authorised under a licence in relation to the radiation source;

basis.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
basis.quote: A person responsible for regulated material must hold a radiation management licence in respect of the regulated material and must comply with any conditions to which the licence is subject.
A person must not possess a radiation source, unless the person is allowed to possess it under a possession licence
